Residents in low-lying areas such as Gwarinpa and the surrounding neighborhoods may experience slight flooding if the predicted 63% chance of rain materializes. Models suggest that the rain will likely fall in the late evening, around 9-10 pm, with accumulation ranges between 10-20 mm.

The Maitama and Wuse areas, known for their high elevation, may experience slightly cooler temperatures compared to other parts of the city. However, the humidity will remain relatively high, at 74%, making the air feel sticky and uncomfortable. The rain chance on Monday is significant, but my best guess is that it will be a short-lived event, with the skies clearing up by Tuesday morning. In the meantime, residents can expect a relatively quiet evening, with the only disturbance being the occasional rumble of thunder. The airport road may experience some delays due to the rain, but the impact should be minimal. ### Tuesday The partly cloudy skies will persist into Tuesday, with a high of 30°C and a 65% chance of rain.
